main.description: Bidirectional resolution between the two etzhayyim DID surfaces: `did:web:<handle>.etzhayyim.com` and `did:erc725:base:<contract>#<rootIdHex>`. Accepts either form; returns both, plus the activeKey, the active flag, and the vendor predecessor link if any. Per ADR-2605212030 §D2.

did.description: Either `did:web:<handle>.etzhayyim.com` or `did:erc725:base:<contract>#<rootIdHex>`. Exactly one of `did` or `dwebHandle` or `rootId` must be supplied.

chainId.description: Optional. Default Base mainnet (8453). Use 84532 for Base Sepolia.

predecessorVendorRootHash.description: Present iff the root was created via mirrorVendorRoot.

predecessorVendorAddr.description: Present iff the root was created via mirrorVendorRoot.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No active root matches the supplied identifier.

errors.name: InvalidArgument
errors.description: Exactly one of `did` / `dwebHandle` / `rootId` must be provided.
